# Literature / Resource Checklist

- [ ] Search intent is tied to a decision, not generic browsing.
- [ ] Original/official source inspected where available.
- [ ] Method section/supplement checked when abstract is insufficient.
- [ ] Official implementation path checked when implementation matters.
- [ ] Dataset split/evaluation protocol checked.
- [ ] Pretrained weights/license/runtime constraints checked if relevant.
- [ ] Recent competing work checked for current/SOTA decisions.
- [ ] GitHub issues/PRs checked for practical failure modes when useful.
- [ ] Community claims are not used as sole scientific evidence.
- [ ] Search date and unresolved conflicts recorded.
- [ ] Search stopping rationale stated.
